At some point by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] carried out an '''assault''' on the [[Woern's pirate base|pirate base]] located inside [["Woern's Asteroid"]].<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
